claims: In 2026, the NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed for 10 standard holidays.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on New Year's Day, Thursday, January 1, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Monday, January 19, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Presidents' Day, Monday, February 16, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Good Friday, Friday, April 3, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Memorial Day, Monday, May 25, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Juneteenth, Friday, June 19, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Independence Day (observed), Friday, July 3, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Labor Day, Monday, September 7, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will be closed on Christmas Day, Friday, December 25, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will have an early closure at 1:00 p.m. ET on the day after Thanksgiving, Friday, November 27, 2026.
The NYSE and Nasdaq will have an early closure at 1:00 p.m. ET on Christmas Eve, Thursday, December 24, 2026.
If a holiday falls on a Saturday, the NYSE and Nasdaq close on the preceding Friday.
If a holiday falls on a Sunday, the NYSE and Nasdaq close on the following Monday.
